records.name: Trident Academy
records.description: Trident Academy in Pune offers preparatory training for NDA, CDS, SSB, and defence competitive examinations, taking advantage of Pune's significant military presence including the Southern Command headquarters and IMA supply establishments. The academy provides both classroom coaching and residential programs with strong SSB preparation components including psychology tests and group task simulations. Trident's Pune location allows students guest interactions with active and retired defence officers.

records.name: SAFAL Academy
records.description: SAFAL Academy in New Delhi offers coaching for defence entrance examinations including NDA, CDS, AFCAT, MNS, and SSB interviews. The academy is known for its comprehensive study material, expert faculty with ex-defence officer backgrounds, and regular mock tests aligned with current UPSC and service selection board patterns. SAFAL provides both classroom and online programs, catering to candidates from across India.

records.name: Nation Defence Academy Pune
records.description: National Defence Academy (NDA) in Pune is Asia's first tri-services academy, where cadets from the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force are trained together before their respective service academies. Admission is through UPSC's NDA entrance examination and SSB interview, and the three-year training program combines academics (BA/B.Sc. degree from JNU) with military, naval, and air training. NDA is considered one of the finest military academies in the world and has produced many of India's top military leaders and war heroes.

records.name: Jindal Global Law School
records.description: Jindal Global Law School (JGLS) in Sonipat is India's most internationally oriented law school, part of O.P. Jindal Global University, and consistently ranked among India's top five law schools. It offers five-year B.A. LL.B. and B.B.A. LL.B. programs, LL.M., and Ph.D. degrees with strong faculties in international law, human rights, business law, and comparative law. JGLS has the largest number of international faculty among Indian law schools and maintains academic partnerships with over 200 universities worldwide.

records.name: IIIT Bangalore
records.description: International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore (IIIT-B) is a not-for-profit deemed university specializing in IT and related fields, offering integrated M.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs in machine learning, data science, networked systems, and software engineering. The institute has strong industry research partnerships and its alumni have founded several successful tech startups. IIIT-B's location in India's tech capital Bengaluru provides exceptional opportunities for industry interaction and placement.

records.name: IIT Madras
records.description: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) is India's top-ranked engineering institution, established in 1959 with technical and financial assistance from the Government of Germany. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across 16 academic departments and is home to India's largest research park, with over 200 technology companies housed on campus. IIT Madras is known for pioneering research in ocean engineering, aerospace, data science, and AI, and its alumni ecosystem spans industry, academia, and entrepreneurship globally.

records.name: IIT Kanpur
records.description: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur) is one of India's premier engineering institutions, established in 1959 with collaboration from a consortium of nine American universities. It is particularly renowned for its aerospace engineering, computer science, and chemistry programs, and is recognized as India's top institution for scientific research and publication output per faculty. IIT Kanpur launched India's first computer science program and has been a pioneer in cybersecurity education, operating the C3i Cyber Security Centre of Excellence.

records.name: IIT Bombay
records.description: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay) is one of India's foremost engineering and research institutions, established in 1958 with technical assistance from UNESCO and the Soviet Union. Located on the Powai lakeside campus in Mumbai, it offers programs across engineering, sciences, design, management, and humanities, and is India's highest-placed IIT in international rankings. IIT Bombay is known for its entrepreneurial culture with hundreds of startups, the prestigious annual Techfest, and the IDC School of Design, Asia's top design school.

records.name: Bennett University
records.description: Bennett University in Greater Noida is a private university established by the Times Group, offering programs in engineering, media, law, and management with an emphasis on technology and media convergence. The university has strong industry partnerships leveraging the Times Group's vast media ecosystem, particularly for journalism, media, and digital content programs. Bennett's Centre of Excellence in AI, blockchain, and IoT provides students exposure to cutting-edge technologies.

records.name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology
records.description: SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) in Chennai is one of India's largest private deemed universities, with over 52,000 students across its Kattankulathur, Ramapuram, and NCR campuses. It offers programs in engineering, medicine, law, science, and management, and is known for strong industry connections particularly in automotive, IT, and manufacturing sectors. SRM has research collaborations with NASA, ISRO, and several international universities, and its engineering graduates are placed at top technology companies worldwide.
